text:
Sofia: FYI my docs PR 4591 preview on Vercel returns 404 for /sdk/python/quickstart — build shows success but the routing is wrong.
Sofia: Console shows site deployed at /_vercel/docs-site but links expect /docs/ so Netlify/other previews worked fine.
Nikhil: Sounds like site_url/base_url mismatch in mkdocs config. Can you paste mkdocs.yml snippet?
Sofia: snippet:
```
site_name: Redwood Inference Docs
site_url: https://redwood.ai/docs
use_directory_urls: true
extra:
  base_url: /docs/
```
Sofia: I added base_url to handle our prod reverse proxy, but Vercel preview appends the project slug so path becomes /_vercel/docs-site/docs/sdk/python -> 404.
Ruth: Quick fix: remove base_url for previews or set it dynamically with an ENV var in the build. e.g., in CI set MKDOCS_BASE_URL="" for previews.
Owen: We don't want to change prod behavior. Alternative: add a small redirect rule in vercel.json for previews to strip the /docs prefix.
Nikhil: For immediate unblock — is this blocking merges? There's a 02:00 UTC merge window tonight.
Sofia: It's just an SDK snippet and a migration note. If linkcheck and lint pass I'm ok with manual approval/merge. Would prefer someone sanity-check the code block rendering though.
Ruth: I'll review content now. If it's only the preview mismatch and everything else is green, we can merge with label `docs/preview-baseurl` and follow-up issue.
ci-bot: preview build 456 succeeded; production build 789 succeeded; vercel-preview 457 returned status SUCCESS but the deployed path differs (see logs).
Owen: Local repro steps I used:
```bash
pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material
export MKDOCS_BASE_URL=""
mkdocs build
mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000
# open http://127.0.0.1:8000/sdk/python/quickstart
```
Nikhil: Proposed rollout: 1) Ruth does content LGTM, 2) add `docs/preview-baseurl` label, 3) merge after linkcheck passes, 4) open follow-up issue `docs#212` for build-time env handling.
Sofia: Added label and repro notes to the PR, assigned `docs#212` to Owen.
Ruth: Content LGTM. :thumbsup:
Sofia: Thanks all — will merge after the remaining CI jobs finish and coordinate with release team about the merge window to avoid staging e2e collisions.
